# custom_group (Resource)

Manages groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage example group.
resource "custom_group" "example" {
  title = "Build custom terraform provider"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Group title.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) String uuid identifier of the group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Order can be imported by specifying the string uuid identifier.
terraform import custom_group.example 42015d3b-3ab6-4355-8361-b65aa5223a6a
```
